title: Simple, personal and awesome
slide_intent: Translate abstract brand principles into different visual situations so teams can recognize what those principles mean in practice.
strategic_value: The three recurring principles can give Xfinity’s varied teams a shared basis for making design decisions.
demonstration: The eight-second sequence moves from a green check and keep it simple to a gateway and phone with make it personal, then a dimensional heart with embrace the awesome.
practical_value: Pair each principle with a concrete example before using it to evaluate a design direction.

content_islands.name: Simple principle
content_islands.spec: Build a green circular check beside the words keep it simple on the pale field.

content_islands.name: Personal principle
content_islands.spec: Overlay make it personal on a domestic gateway-and-phone scene with a ring of light.

content_islands.name: Awesome principle
content_islands.spec: Set embrace the awesome across a large heart on a vivid pink field.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying agency text says the principles simple, personal and awesome drive unity across internal teams and external agencies.
reference_purposes.Expression: Distinct check, product and heart scenes give the three principles visual character.
reference_purposes.Application: The sequence pairs each principle with a concrete graphic or product example.
